objective.engineering_target: At least 40 strict passes out of the frozen 56-task protocol after local and small-scale gates.
objective.first_order_goal: Make the combined mechanism reachable and measurable without violating privacy, protocol, or runtime budgets.

G11.retained_runtime_role: Own work-state revision, supersession, active-head lifecycle, step identity, observation-reference provenance, and unknown preservation.

G12.retained_runtime_role: Classify uncertainty/fault/freshness and deterministically select one bounded structural action.

G13.retained_runtime_role: Represent active requirement rows, bind opaque visible observations, and update structural coverage, freshness, and fault states.

unified_carrier.name: revisioned_requirement_evidence_state_v1
unified_carrier.transport: Exactly one model-authored string payload through the existing configured self-observation tool-call boundary.

fields.supersedes: null for revision 1, otherwise exact prior state_id and revision
fields.plan_steps: ordered array of opaque step tokens
fields.declared_next_action: optional enum only; never trusted as runtime-selected action

unified_carrier.legacy_behavior: Reject nested, mixed, G11-only, G12-only, or G13-only carriers in integrated mode; preserve unknown and continue base behavior.

runtime_transitions.effect: Install one task-agnostic authoring contract without adding a model turn.
Parse exactly one payload; do not persist raw IDs or content to research exports.
Emit no state or view; record activation miss only.
Activate the revision and derive only structural provenance.
Preserve unknown, suppress the view, and continue base behavior.
Update coverage, freshness, availability, and fault states deterministically.
Apply the frozen action precedence and choose at most one structural action.
Render one allowlisted structural view with opaque target token.
Emit no view and do not alter model choice.
Wait for the model's ordinary next action; initiate no tool call.
Classify the structural action and attach later visible observations.

action_precedence.condition: instrumentation_loss, boundary_mismatch, malformed, truncated, or unknown provenance
active requirement is uncovered, failed, or unavailable with valid provenance
row lifecycle or step mapping is invalid but carrier revision is otherwise valid
active-head plan lifecycle needs structural revision
all active rows are structurally observed and current

runtime_invariants.rule: Exactly one carrier schema, parser, active state store, controller, and model-facing view path exist in integrated mode.
Only model-authored carriers can create or revise active state; runtime synthesis of rows, refs, or revisions is forbidden.
An observation ref is valid only when it names exactly one genuinely model-visible prior same-task ordinary observation.
Structural unique/observed/resolved never means semantic support, relevance, completeness, correctness, confidence, or truth.
Unknown remains unknown on missing, malformed, ambiguous, truncated, stale, failed, unavailable, rejected, or instrumentation-loss input.
The mechanism never initiates a tool call, forces a dispatch, blocks the model's ordinary tool choice, or forces a final answer.
No scoring, evaluator, task set, hint mode, model, provider, database, or 1200-second wall limit is changed.
No raw task, answer, hint, validator, message, tool argument/result, trace, identifier, opaque token, or credential is persisted in research exports.
Disabled mode is observationally equivalent to the selected parent outside absent mechanism telemetry.
A zero-record or zero-view run is reported as untested; strict score alone never supports or refutes the mechanism.
Cohorts and denominators are reported separately; strict-verdict unknowns stay unknown and timeouts stay failures.
No automatic retry follows authentication, quota, provider, schema, privacy, or invariant failure.

fail_closed_rules.result: no state, no view, base behavior, activation_miss telemetry

fail_closed_rules.trigger: carrier invalid, duplicate, mixed, malformed, or oversized
fail_closed_rules.result: reject, preserve unknown, no view, base behavior
keep prior valid head if any, mark revision_invalid, no view from rejected revision

fail_closed_rules.trigger: reference non-visible, ambiguous, truncated, failed, or unavailable
fail_closed_rules.result: do not resolve row; preserve structural state and select only the fixed fail-closed action if eligible
preserve unknown, suppress content-bearing action, continue base behavior
invalidate candidate or run immediately; do not export affected artifact

fail_closed_rules.trigger: cap reached or remaining time <= 180 seconds
fail_closed_rules.result: suppress all further views; never extend or reset deadline
stop the authorized attempt; no automatic retry or alternate carrier

implementation_surface.strategy: One new candidate-side integrated state/controller module plus minimal adapters at existing self-observation creation, provider response, model-facing message, analyzer, and evidence-pack boundaries.
implementation_surface.prompt_strategy: One concise task-agnostic authoring contract; do not concatenate G11, G12, and G13 prompts.

local_tests.test: Exact unified schema, limits, enums, token grammar, and additional-field rejection.
Revision 1, monotonic revisions, exact supersession, active-head uniqueness, duplicate and stale revision rejection.
Opaque reference visibility, uniqueness, same-task, pre-boundary, truncation, failure, and non-evidence exclusion.
Every coverage/freshness/fault transition and unknown-preservation path.
Deterministic action precedence for every pairwise and multi-row conflict.
No view for absent/invalid state, proceed, unchanged state, cap, deadline, or unknown boundary.
At most one view per turn, three per task, three attributable extra turns/dispatches, and zero initiated calls.
Enabled/disabled inertness for control flow, dispatch, results, scoring, timeout, and final answer outside the view channel.
Provider-shaped response fixtures for accepted, missing, malformed, truncated, rejected, and boundary-mismatch carriers without a live provider.
Prohibited-content sentinels across logs, sidecars, summaries, normalized traces, analyzer output, and evidence packs.
Aggregate endpoints, cohort denominators, zero-activation untested status, and no pooled rates.
End-to-end fixture: author -> validate -> observe -> assess -> present -> later action -> revise -> finalize.
All inherited relevant G11, G12, and G13 structural tests pass or are explicitly mapped to a replaced unified invariant.
No credential names or values, network access, database access, model calls, or benchmark execution in local tests.

small_scale_gate.selection: Before candidate execution, bind six anonymous frozen-manifest indices selected without task text: three from G13 known_strict_fail, one completed_strict_verdict_unknown, one timeout_failure, and one strict_pass guardrail. Freeze selection and reference outcomes before launch.
small_scale_gate.protocol: Base/no-hint, same model/provider/database and evaluator as the frozen protocol, 1200 seconds per task, one worker unless an authorized preflight requires otherwise, no automatic SDK retry, one candidate attempt only.
no_go_if: Any privacy, protocol, invariant, scoring, timeout, forced-action, or carrier-integrity violation occurs.
Valid authored state appears in fewer than four tasks.
Fewer than two tasks deliver a view with a later measurable action.
Any sufficient-budget later action is structurally contradictory.
The prior strict-pass guardrail regresses or no prior non-pass task becomes strict pass.
Authentication, quota, provider, schema, database, or benchmark infrastructure fails; do not retry automatically.
small_scale_gate.interpretation: Passing is an engineering activation gate only. It is not benchmark benefit or causal evidence.

preconditions: All local tests pass in an isolated candidate tree.
Independent source, privacy, and contract review passes.
The small-scale gate passes exactly as predeclared.
Candidate tree, task manifest, protocol, model/provider, evaluator, database boundary, telemetry schema, and launch manifest hashes are frozen before launch.
A fresh bounded environment and credential-name-only preflight passes without exposing values.
frozen_56_promotion_gate.interpretation: At least 40/56 is the promotion threshold, not a promised result. A passing single unpaired run remains descriptive and cannot establish causal benefit.

stop_conditions: Stop before implementation if source hashes or the selected parent boundary cannot be frozen.
Stop before any external run if a local test, privacy scan, or independent review fails.
Stop the attempt on the first authentication, quota, provider, schema, database, privacy, or invariant failure; do not retry automatically.
Stop after the small-scale gate and require a new explicit authorization for the frozen 56-task run.
Stop after one authorized 56-task run and report descriptive results without repair rerun or hidden arm.
